description: WebSocketTransport outer layer, applied to every relayed payload once poolSharedSecret is set (inner E2E encryption is separate).
notes: wsEncryptionKey/encryptForWS/decryptFromWS are private in WebSocketTransport (separate repo), so these vectors are verified by the reference implementation only.
HKDF is called without a salt: identical to an empty salt and to 32 zero bytes (RFC 5869).
Before a shared secret is configured, frames pass through as plaintext in both directions.
